I saw my friend open WINE with no tinkering and run Dark Souls PTD edition pretty much flawlessly (it's a shitty port, so you can only do so much). Modding it broke it though.

He then proceeded to try every game in his Steam library that wasn't available for Linux, and his success rate was like 80-90%.

All he did was install WINE on Linux, then install Steam (the program) in WINE, then point it at his old Windows partition with his old Steam Library on it and it saw every game by default. After moving his saves, he now games exclusively on Linux.
